AI.result: 在多个推理基准测试上持续优于强基线方法，且迭代过程中保持可靠的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 验证了元优化能有效使智能体从经验中学习并持续增强推理能力。

title: Beyond English benchmarks: clinical llm evaluation in Brazilian Portuguese
summary: Large Language Models are transforming the support for clinical decision and their application in real scenarios. Yet, most benchmarks are conducted in English, and cross-lingual evaluation is needed to tackle the language gaps in global access. We introduce ClinicalBr, the first bilingual benchmark for clinical decision built from real Brazilian case reports. The corpus contains 2,892 cases drawn from 28 SciELO medical journals, spanning 18 specialties, and is structured as parallel Portuguese-English pairs. Each case supports four evaluation tasks: diagnosis retrieval, differential diagnosis, exam recommendation, and treatment planning. We evaluate four models: MedGemma-27B, Sabiá-4, DeepSeek-R1, and o3-mini, across both languages. The central finding is that the Portuguese-English performance gap is task-dependent, not general. In diagnosis retrieval, English yields a consistent advantage across all models, with +7.5-12.1 accuracy points. This advantage disappears in differential diagnosis, exam recommendation, and treatment planning, where confidence intervals cross zero for most models and Portuguese completeness scores are marginally higher. Brazilian-endemic conditions proved easier than the full corpus, not harder, indicating that tropical presentations are adequately represented in current pre-training. Exam recommendation was the hardest task across all models and both languages, with F1 scores below 0.10, well below the differential diagnosis ceiling of 0.20-0.27.

AI.tldr: ClinicalBr是首个基于巴西真实病例报告的双语临床决策基准，包含2892个涵盖18个专业的病例，支持四项评估任务。研究发现葡萄牙语-英语的性能差距取决于具体任务，并非普遍存在：诊断检索任务中英语有明显优势，但在其他三项任务中差距消失，巴西特有病症反而更容易处理。
AI.motivation: 现有临床决策基准大多基于英语，缺乏跨语言评估，无法解决全球医疗可及性中的语言鸿沟问题。
AI.method: 构建ClinicalBr双语基准语料库，包含2892个来自28种SciELO医学期刊的巴西病例报告，涵盖18个专科，以葡萄牙语-英语平行对形式组织。设计四项评估任务：诊断检索、鉴别诊断、检查推荐和治疗规划。评估MedGemma-27B、Sabiá-4、DeepSeek-R1和o3-mini四种模型。
AI.result: 诊断检索任务中英语优势显著（+7.5-12.1准确率点）；鉴别诊断、检查推荐和治疗规划任务中语言差异不显著；巴西特有病症表现更好；检查推荐是难度最大的任务（F1<0.10），鉴别诊断表现相对较好（F1 0.20-0.27）。
AI.conclusion: 葡萄牙语-英语性能差距具有任务依赖性，提示跨语言临床NLP评估需要针对具体任务进行，而非笼统判断语言优劣。

title: VATS: Exploiting Implicit Authority in Error-Path Injection via Systematic Mutation
comment: Published at Second Workshop on Agents in the Wild: Safety, Security, and Beyond (ICML 2026 AIWILD)
summary: As the Model Context Protocol (MCP) standardizes tool-calling for autonomous agents, it introduces a critical, unexamined attack surface: the error-handling loop. We hypothesize that tool error messages possess implicit authority, triggering corrective reasoning modes that bypass standard safety heuristics. We introduce VATS (Vulnerability Analysis of Tool Streams), a mutation-driven framework that systematically evolves adversarial payloads across seven structural and linguistic dimensions. Our evaluation across four frontier models, Gemini 3.1 Pro, GPT-5.5, GLM-5.1, and Qwen3-Coder, demonstrates that error-path injection triples the success rate of standard indirect prompt injection (IPI), achieving up to 100% compliance in controlled evaluations. We isolate structural positioning (sandwiching instructions within error context) as the most effective exploit vector across all tested models. While we find that production framework guardrails can mitigate these vulnerabilities, the inherent susceptibility of the model layer poses a systemic risk to bespoke agentic workflows.

AI.tldr: 本文发现MCP协议中的错误处理循环存在安全漏洞：错误信息具有隐式权威性，会触发模型绕过安全机制进行修正推理。提出的VATS框架通过变异驱动方式生成对抗性载荷，在四个前沿模型上实现错误路径注入攻击，成功率是标准间接提示注入的三倍，最高可达100%的顺从率。
AI.motivation: MCP协议标准化了工具调用机制，但其中错误处理循环这一攻击面尚未被充分研究。作者假设工具错误信息具有隐式权威性，可能绕过标准安全启发式规则。
AI.method: 提出VATS（工具流漏洞分析）框架，采用变异驱动方式，在七个结构和语言维度上系统演化对抗性载荷。在Gemini 3.1 Pro、GPT-5.5、GLM-5.1和Qwen3-Coder四个前沿模型上评估。
AI.result: 错误路径注入使标准间接提示注入（IPI）的成功率提升了三倍，在受控评估中最高达到100%的顺从率。将指令夹在错误上下文中（结构性定位）是跨所有测试模型最有效的利用向量。
AI.conclusion: 虽然生产框架的护栏可以缓解这些漏洞，但模型层固有的易感性对定制化智能体工作流构成了系统性风险。

title: Contribution Weights: A Geometrical Analysis of Self-Attention Transformers
summary: Analyzing attention weights has become a standard approach for interpreting the information flow of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, this approach has significant limitations as it neglects the geometric properties of the value vectors being aggregated. To address this gap, we introduce \emph{Contribution Weights}, a projection-based metric that quantifies a token's influence by accounting for it's attention weight, value magnitude, and directional alignment with the layer output. We demonstrate that contribution weights provide a more faithful measure of token importance, consistently outperforming attention-based metrics in identifying semantically critical tokens across different decoder-only models, tasks, and datasets. Further, our metric enables novel mechanistic analysis of \emph{attention sinks}. While previous work characterized sinks as passive repositories for excess attention, we reveal they serve an active functional role, suppressing information through a convex relationship between sink rate and output norm, stabilizing representations by opposing the semantic drift of low-confidence tokens.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“贡献权重”（Contribution Weights）指标，通过投影方法结合注意力权重、值向量大小和方向对齐，更准确地量化LLM中token的重要性，并揭示了注意力汇聚（attention sinks）的主动功能角色——通过凸关系抑制信息、稳定表示。
AI.motivation: 现有基于注意力权重的方法忽略了值向量的几何特性（如大小和方向），导致对token重要性的度量不够准确。
AI.method: 提出贡献权重（Contribution Weights），一种基于投影的度量，综合考虑注意力权重、值向量的大小及其与层输出的方向对齐程度。
AI.result: 贡献权重在识别语义关键token方面始终优于基于注意力权重的指标；并发现注意力汇聚（attention sinks）具有主动功能角色，通过凸关系抑制信息、稳定表示。
AI.conclusion: 贡献权重提供了一种更忠实的token重要性度量，并揭示了注意力汇聚的主动功能机制，挑战了其被动存储的传统观点。

title: The Cold-Start Safety Gap in LLM Agents
summary: Are tool-calling LLM agents equally safe throughout a conversation? We discover they are not: agents are most vulnerable at the very start of a session and become substantially safer after a few regular agentic tasks -- a phenomenon we term the cold-start safety gap. To study this systematically, we introduce Safety Over Depth for Agents (SODA), a benchmark that controls how many regular agentic tasks the agent completes before encountering a safety threat, supporting up to 20 preceding tasks. Evaluating 7 models from 4 families, safety improves by 9--52% as the number of preceding regular agentic tasks increases from zero to twenty. Representation analysis confirms that model hidden states gradually shift toward a safety-aligned region as more preceding tasks are present. By systematically studying which part of the preceding conversation matters most, we find that the regular agentic tasks themselves are the primary driver of safety, while the agent's own prior responses have less effect on safety but are essential for preserving later utility. This conclusion is further supported by evaluation on open-source safety benchmarks (AgentHarm, Agent Safety Bench) and utility benchmarks (BFCL, API-Bank), confirming that warming up the agent with regular agentic tasks before deployment makes it safer and preserves full capability. Based on these findings, we recommend a simple deployment strategy: having the agent complete a few regular agentic tasks before possible exposure to safety-critical requests mitigates the cold-start safety gap. Our code is available at https://github.com/Trustworthy-ML-Lab/Agent-Cold-Start-Safety-Gap

AI.tldr: 论文发现工具调用型LLM智能体在对话初期存在安全漏洞（冷启动安全差距），随着完成常规任务数量增加（0到20个），安全性提升9-52%。通过SODA基准测试和表征分析证实这一现象，并提出部署前让智能体执行若干常规任务的安全策略。
AI.motivation: 现有研究缺乏对LLM智能体在对话全过程中安全性动态变化的系统分析，作者发现智能体在会话开始时最脆弱，随着对话推进安全性提升，但这一现象尚未被系统研究。
AI.method: 提出SODA基准测试，控制智能体在遇到安全威胁前完成的常规任务数量（支持最多20个前置任务）；对7个模型（4个系列）进行安全评估；进行表征分析观察隐藏状态变化；在AgentHarm、Agent Safety Bench、BFCL、API-Bank等基准上验证。
AI.result: 前置常规任务从0增加到20时，安全性提升9-52%；隐藏状态逐渐向安全对齐区域偏移；常规任务本身是安全提升的主要驱动力，智能体自身先前回答对安全性影响较小但有助于保持后续效用。
AI.conclusion: 建议部署策略：让智能体在可能面临安全关键请求前完成若干常规任务，以缓解冷启动安全差距。

title: Efficient Skill Grounding via Code Refactoring with Small Language Models
summary: Effective skill grounding is essential for deploying reusable skills in embodied agents, as even minor embodiment or environmental differences can render an entire skill incompatible. This challenge is particularly pronounced in embodied settings, where agents must operate in dynamic, partially observable environments without access to large language models (LLMs). In this setting, reliance on LLMs is impractical, while small language models (sLMs) remain insufficient for the effective skill grounding required for reliable long-horizon control. We present RECENT, a refactoring-centric agent framework that enables efficient skill grounding with sLMs by decoupling skill semantics from embodiment- and environment-specific execution binding. By representing skills as executable code, RECENT preserves the semantic intent encoded in a skill's control structure while grounding it by modifying only execution bindings through localized refactoring, rather than regenerating code from scratch. We evaluate RECENT across diverse skill grounding scenarios spanning multiple robot embodiments in dynamic environments, demonstrating robust long-horizon performance when deployed with an sLM. Across all scenarios, RECENT achieves the best performance among sLM-based Code-as-Policies (CaP) methods and matches the task performance of LLM-based CaP.

AI.tldr: RECENT是一个基于重构的智能体框架，通过将技能语义与执行绑定解耦，使小语言模型（sLM）能够高效进行技能接地，在动态环境中实现与大型语言模型（LLM）相当的长时程控制性能。
AI.motivation: 在具身智能场景中，技能接地面临严峻挑战：微小的具身形态或环境差异就会导致整个技能失效。而LLM在实际部署中不实用，sLM又不足以支持可靠的技能接地和长时程控制。
AI.method: 提出RECENT框架，将技能表示为可执行代码，通过局部重构（localized refactoring）只修改执行绑定（execution bindings）来实现技能接地，无需从头重新生成代码，从而保留了技能的语义控制结构。
AI.result: 在多种机器人形态和动态环境下的技能接地场景中，RECENT在基于sLM的Code-as-Policies方法中表现最佳，且任务性能与基于LLM的CaP方法相当。
AI.conclusion: RECENT框架通过解耦技能语义与执行绑定，使得小语言模型也能有效完成技能接地，在无需依赖LLM的情况下实现鲁棒的长时程控制。

title: SRT: Super-Resolution for Time Series via Disentangled Rectified Flow
comment: Accepted to the International Conference on Learning Representations (ICLR) 2026
summary: Fine-grained time series data with high temporal resolution is critical for accurate analytics across a wide range of applications. However, the acquisition of such data is often limited by cost and feasibility. This problem can be tackled by reconstructing high-resolution signals from low-resolution inputs based on specific priors, known as super-resolution. While extensively studied in computer vision, directly transferring image super-resolution techniques to time series is not trivial. To address this challenge at a fundamental level, we propose Super-Resolution for Time series (SRT), a novel framework that reconstructs temporal patterns lost in low-resolution inputs via disentangled rectified flow. SRT decomposes the input into trend and seasonal components, aligns them to the target resolution using an implicit neural representation, and leverages a novel cross-resolution attention mechanism to guide the generation of high-resolution details. We further introduce SRT-large, a scaled-up version with extensive pre-training, which enables strong zero-shot super-resolution capability. Extensive experiments on nine public datasets demonstrate that SRT and SRT-large consistently outperform existing methods across multiple scale factors, showing both robust performance and the effectiveness of each component in our architecture.

AI.tldr: 提出SRT框架，通过解耦整流流、隐式神经表示和跨分辨率注意力机制，实现时间序列的超分辨率重建，SRT-large版本在大规模预训练后具备零样本超分辨能力，在9个数据集上表现优异。
AI.motivation: 高时间分辨率的时间序列数据获取成本高，现有图像超分辨率方法无法直接迁移到时间序列领域，亟需专门针对时间序列的超分辨率方法。
AI.method: 将输入分解为趋势和季节性成分，通过隐式神经表示对齐到目标分辨率，并引入跨分辨率注意力机制来指导高分辨率细节生成。SRT-large进一步扩大模型规模并进行大规模预训练。
AI.result: 在9个公开数据集上，SRT和SRT-large在多个缩放因子下均持续优于现有方法，各组件均有效。
AI.conclusion: SRT框架有效解决了时间序列超分辨率问题，大规模预训练版本具备零样本泛化能力，验证了方法的鲁棒性和各组件设计的有效性。

title: Whose Norms? Disentangling Cultural and Personal Alignment in Large Language Models
summary: Large language models are increasingly used for social decision-making situations that require balancing cultural norms with personal preferences. For example, a user preferring honesty might ask whether to correct a coworker publicly when local norms favor indirect feedback. Yet existing research studies cultural alignment and personalization largely separately. We introduce PACT, the Personal-Preference and Cultural-Norm Trade-off framework, which evaluates whether models choose to follow a cultural norm or allow personal preferences. We find that LLMs vary in how rigidly they enforce cultural norms, with behavior shifted more by country context (7.8%) than age (1%) and gender (0.7%) and shifting non-uniformly after instruction tuning. Furthermore, our five-country human study on PACT shows that culture-following in humans is mainly driven by scenario country, with the lowest agreement when participants judge their own cultural contexts, showing within-culture pluralism. Finally, human-LLM alignment experiments show that models can match majority choices, but fail to capture response distributions and uncertainty (with best correlations reaching only 0.24). Together, these findings motivate alignment evaluations that go beyond majority to capture cultural pluralism and disagreement in social judgment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PACT框架，用于评估大语言模型在社交决策中如何在文化规范与个人偏好之间权衡。研究发现模型对不同国家（7.8%）、年龄（1%）和性别（0.7%）的规范遵循程度存在差异，且人类文化遵循主要由国家背景驱动。模型能匹配多数选择，但无法捕捉响应分布和不确定性（相关性仅0.24），表明需要超越多数投票的文化对齐评估。
AI.motivation: 现有研究将文化对齐和个性化问题分开研究，缺乏统一框架来评估模型在社交决策中如何平衡文化规范与个人偏好。
AI.method: 提出PACT（Personal-Preference and Cultural-Norm Trade-off）框架，通过系统评估模型在不同国家、年龄、性别上下文中的文化规范遵循程度；进行五国人类研究；开展人机对齐实验。
AI.result: 1) 模型文化规范刚性因模型而异，国家上下文影响最大（7.8%），年龄（1%）和性别（0.7%）影响较小；2) 指令微调后变化非均匀；3) 人类文化遵循主要由场景国家驱动，在判断自身文化背景时一致性最低；4) 模型能匹配多数选择，但无法捕捉响应分布和不确定性（最佳相关性仅0.24）。
AI.conclusion: 需要超越多数投票的对齐评估方法，以捕捉文化多元性和社会判断中的分歧。

title: UniQL: Towards Dialect-Universal Benchmarking for Text-to-SQL
summary: Existing text-to-SQL benchmarks are largely centered on SQLite, making it difficult to evaluate whether models can generalize across heterogeneous SQL dialects. However, real-world database systems differ substantially in syntax, functions, type systems, and execution semantics, so the same natural language intent often requires dialect-specific SQL realizations. We introduce UniQL, a human-verified benchmark for cross-dialect text-to-SQL evaluation. UniQL aligns 1,534 natural language questions with executable SQL annotations across 16 SQL dialects, yielding 24,544 dialect-specific queries. All dialects share the same intents, aligned schemas and database contents, enabling controlled evaluation of dialect generalization. UniQL is constructed through a hybrid pipeline combining database migration, SQL translation, execution-guided verification, iterative rule summarization, and human validation. Experiments on both open-source and closed-source LLMs show that current models remain far from dialect-universal, with substantial performance variation across database systems and limited transfer from SQLite success to other dialects. These findings highlight the need for aligned cross-dialect benchmarks and more dialect-aware text-to-SQL methods. Code and data are available at https://github.com/JerryGao818/UniQL

AI.tldr: 本文提出了UniQL，一个包含16种SQL方言、24,544条可执行查询的人工验证跨方言Text-to-SQL基准，实验表明当前模型远未实现方言通用，亟需方言感知的Text-to-SQL方法。
AI.motivation: 现有Text-to-SQL基准大多集中在SQLite上，无法评估模型对不同SQL方言的泛化能力，而实际数据库系统在语法、函数、类型系统和执行语义上差异巨大，相同自然语言意图需要不同方言的SQL实现。
AI.method: 通过混合流水线构建：数据库迁移、SQL翻译、执行引导验证、迭代规则总结和人工验证，最终对齐1,534个自然语言问题与16种SQL方言的24,544条可执行查询，所有方言共享相同意图、对齐模式和数据库内容。
AI.result: 开源和闭源LLM的实验表明，当前模型远未实现方言通用，不同数据库系统之间性能差异显著，从SQLite成功到其他方言的迁移能力有限。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现凸显了对齐的跨方言基准和更方言感知的Text-to-SQL方法的必要性。

title: QDSP: An Interpretable Structured Learning Framework for Predicting Death or Cerebral Palsy in Very Low Birth Weight Infants
summary: Very low birth weight infants (VLBWI) are at high risk of mortality and severe neurodevelopmental impairment, including cerebral palsy, yet reliable discharge-time prognostic stratification remains challenging in high-dimensional and data-limited clinical settings. To address this problem, we propose QDSP, an interpretable structured learning framework that integrates Quota-guided Subspace Sampling (QSS) and Differentiable-decision-guided Structure Perception (DSP). The QSS module constructs stability-aware and low-redundancy feature subspaces through bootstrap-based feature consistency estimation, whereas the DSP module employs differentiable soft oblique decision structures to model nonlinear clinical interactions while preserving traceable decision evidence. The proposed framework was evaluated on a real-world VLBWI cohort comprising 51 infants and further validated on three public medical tabular datasets. On the primary cohort, QDSP achieved an accuracy of 0.9200 and an AUC of 0.9714, outperforming representative machine learning and deep tabular learning baselines, including XGBoost, TabNet, and TabPFN. Across external datasets, QDSP maintained competitive discrimination and calibration under varying sample sizes and clinical distributions. In addition, SHAP-based analyses and differentiable decision-path tracing identified clinically relevant predictors, including cystic periventricular leukomalacia (cPVL) and birth weight, consistent with established neonatal pathophysiological evidence. These results suggest that QDSP provides an interpretable and robust framework for discharge-time risk stratification in VLBWI and may support early individualized clinical decision-making in neonatal intensive care settings.

AI.tldr: 提出QDSP框架，一种结合配额引导子空间采样和可微决策结构感知的可解释结构化学习方法，用于极低出生体重婴儿出院时的死亡和神经发育障碍风险分层，在51名婴儿的真实队列中准确率达0.92，AUC达0.97。
AI.motivation: 极低出生体重婴儿死亡和严重神经发育障碍风险高，但在高维、小样本临床场景下出院时预后分层仍具挑战性。
AI.method: 提出QDSP框架，包含配额引导子空间采样（QSS）模块通过自助法特征一致性估计构建稳定低冗余特征子空间，以及可微决策引导结构感知（DSP）模块采用可微软斜决策结构建模非线性临床交互并保留可追溯的决策证据。
AI.result: 在51名VLBWI队列上准确率0.92、AUC 0.97，优于XGBoost、TabNet、TabPFN等基线模型；在三个公开医疗表格数据集上保持竞争力；SHAP分析和可微决策路径追踪识别出囊性脑室周围白质软化和出生体重等临床相关预测因子。
AI.conclusion: QDSP为VLBWI出院时风险分层提供了可解释且鲁棒的框架，可能支持新生儿重症监护中早期个体化临床决策。

title: Beyond Individual Personas: Aligning Synthetic Dialogue to Population-Level Behavior Distributions
summary: Synthetic dialogue corpora are increasingly used as proxies for target dialogue data, yet persona-grounded generators optimize individual conversations rather than corpus composition, yielding locally plausible dialogues with distorted population-level behavior mixes. We introduce GroupPersona, a framework that aligns synthetic dialogue corpora to the behavior distribution of a reference corpus. GroupPersona turns population statistics into generation controls: it separates each dialogue's core behavioral signature from predictable side effects, and uses the resulting behavioral groups to condition user agents on the interaction patterns that define the reference population. We evaluate GroupPersona on four corpora crossing two dialogue sources, assistant-style and Reddit-derived, with two construction variants: structure-preserving and variation-enhanced. GroupPersona lowers Jensen-Shannon divergence between synthetic and reference distributions over 12 behavior attributes from 0.234 to 0.177 relative to the strongest average baseline, a 24.4% reduction, and is best or tied-best on all four corpora while preserving structural alignment. It also achieves the closest calibration to reference-conversation quality scores, reducing mean absolute deviation from the reference-conversation profile to 0.63 versus 0.91 for the next-best baseline.

AI.tldr: GroupPersona通过将群体行为分布对齐到参考语料库，显著提升了合成对话语料库的真实性，在12个行为属性上JSD降低24.4%，质量校准误差减少至0.63。
AI.motivation: 现有基于人格的对话生成器优化的是单轮对话的合理性，而非整个语料库的群体行为分布，导致合成数据在人口层面的行为混合失真。
AI.method: 提出GroupPersona框架，将参考语料库的群体统计信息转化为生成控制信号：分离对话的核心行为特征与可预测副作用，提取行为分组，并用这些分组来调节用户代理的交互模式。
AI.result: 在四个语料库上，GroupPersona将12个行为属性的JSD从0.234降至0.177（降幅24.4%），在所有语料库上达到最佳或并列最佳；质量校准的绝对偏差降至0.63（次优基线为0.91）。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式对齐群体行为分布，GroupPersona能有效解决合成对话语料库中的人口层面失真问题，同时保持结构对齐。

title: OSMGraphCLIP: Learning Global Location Representations from OpenStreetMap Graphs
summary: We present OSMGraphCLIP, a CLIP-style geospatial representation model that learns global location embeddings from freely available OpenStreetMap (OSM) data. OSMGraphCLIP represents geographic environments as heterogeneous graphs of typed OSM features, preserving the topological and semantic relationships among roads, buildings, land-use regions, and points of interest. A multi-scale graph encoder captures both fine-grained local structure and broader landscape composition, and supervises a spherical-harmonics location encoder through a contrastive alignment objective. We evaluate OSMGraphCLIP across a diverse suite of downstream geospatial regression and classification tasks spanning climate, ecology, socioeconomic indicators, public health, land cover, biodiversity, and wildfire forecasting, and show that structured OSM data alone supports strong global location representations across domains. OSMGraphCLIP matches or exceeds satellite-based baselines on the majority of benchmarks, with the most pronounced advantage on socioeconomic and public-health tasks, where OSM's explicit semantic annotation of the built environment encodes patterns of human activity that satellite pixels can only capture indirectly. On ecological and environmental tasks, the model remains closely competitive with imagery-based methods despite using no Earth observation data. Qualitative analysis confirms that the learned embeddings organize geographic space coherently, recovering biome boundaries, urban gradients, and tropical--temperate distinctions from map topology alone.

AI.tldr: OSMGraphCLIP是一个基于OpenStreetMap数据的CLIP风格地理空间表示模型，通过异构图表征地理环境，在多项下游任务中达到或超过基于卫星图像的基线模型，尤其在社会经济和公共卫生任务中表现突出。
AI.motivation: 现有地理空间表示模型多依赖卫星遥感图像，而OpenStreetMap这类结构化地图数据蕴含丰富的语义和拓扑信息未被充分利用，作者希望探索仅用OSM数据能否学到强大的全局位置表示。
AI.method: 将地理环境建模为包含道路、建筑、土地利用区域和兴趣点等类型化OSM特征的异构图表征；设计多尺度图编码器捕获细粒度局部结构和宏观景观组成；通过对比学习目标监督球谐函数位置编码器进行训练。
AI.result: 在气候、生态、社会经济、公共卫生、土地覆盖、生物多样性和野火预测等多项任务中，OSMGraphCLIP达到或超过基于卫星图像的基线模型；在社会经济和公共卫生任务上优势最明显；在生态和环境任务上也与基于图像的方法表现相近。
AI.conclusion: 结构化OSM数据本身足以支撑跨领域的强全局位置表示；模型学到的嵌入能够从地图拓扑结构中有意义地组织地理空间，恢复出生物群落边界、城市梯度和热带-温带区分等地理模式。

title: Position: Genomic Model Research Must Move Beyond Anecdotal Evaluation of Interpretability Methods
summary: Advances in machine learning and computational power have unlocked the predictive potential of the human genome, yet biologists now demand that these models also elucidate the underlying biological mechanisms. While interpretable machine learning (IML) techniques have been increasingly applied to bridge this gap, there has been a pervasive reliance on anecdotal validation: the vast majority of research relies on a single IML method and reports only isolated successful instances. Through a benchmarking study on transcription factor binding, we demonstrate the risks of current practices. We show that different IML methods can often (1) yield contradictory explanations for the same predictions, (2) fail to localize known regulatory motifs, and (3) fail to faithfully reflect the model's internal decision process. In light of this, we argue for a validation framework analogous to clinical trials: just as trials require rigorous design and adverse-event reporting, genomic interpretability must move beyond cherry-picked plausibility toward systematic assessment of consistency, faithfulness, and biological validity. To facilitate this, we propose a tiered framework to guide rigorous evaluation and reporting of genomic IML methods.

AI.tldr: 本文通过转录因子结合位点预测的基准测试，揭示了当前基因组可解释机器学习（IML）方法普遍存在的三大问题：不同IML方法给出矛盾解释、无法定位已知调控基序、不能忠实反映模型内部决策。作者类比临床试验，提出了一个分层验证框架，推动基因组IML从"挑例子验证"转向系统化评估。
AI.motivation: 生物学家不仅要求机器学习模型能预测基因组功能，更希望模型能揭示背后的生物学机制。然而当前大多数研究仅依赖单一IML方法并报告孤立的成功案例，这种"挑例子验证"的做法缺乏系统性和可靠性。
AI.method: 在转录因子结合预测任务上开展基准测试，系统比较多种IML方法，评估它们在不同维度上（解释一致性、基序定位能力、对模型决策的忠实度）的表现。
AI.result: 不同IML方法常给出相互矛盾的解释；无法正确识别已知的调控基序；不能忠实反映模型内部真实的决策过程。
AI.conclusion: 基因组可解释性研究需要像临床试验一样，建立严格的评估框架，从一致性、忠实度和生物学有效性三个维度进行系统性评估，而非依赖"挑例子"式的验证。作者提出了分层验证框架以推动这一转变。

title: ROSUM-MCTS: Monte Carlo Tree Search-Inspired HDL Code Summarization with Structural Rewards
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise in code summarization, yet their effectiveness for Hardware Description Languages (HDLs) like VHDL and Verilog remains underexplored. We propose ROSUM-MCTS, an LLM-guided approach inspired by Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) that refines summaries through structured exploration and reinforcement-driven optimization. Our method integrates both local and global context via a hierarchical candidate expansion mechanism and optimizes summaries using a composite reward function balancing functional correctness (FC), local content adequacy (LCA), and fluency. We evaluate ROSUM-MCTS on the VHDL-eval and Verilog-eval datasets, demonstrating its consistent outperformance over baseline methods by leveraging structured bottom-up refinement and reinforcement-based optimization. Ablation studies confirm the necessity of both local and global expansion strategies, as well as the importance of balancing FC and LCA for optimal performance. Furthermore, ROSUM-MCTS proves robust against superficial modifications, such as variable renaming, maintaining summary quality where baselines degrade. These results establish ROSUM-MCTS as an effective and robust HDL summarization framework, paving the way for further research into reinforcement-enhanced code summarization.

AI.tldr: 提出ROSUM-MCTS方法，利用蒙特卡洛树搜索和强化学习优化硬件描述语言（VHDL/Verilog）的代码摘要生成，在多个数据集上优于基线方法。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在代码摘要方面表现良好，但针对硬件描述语言（如VHDL和Verilog）的有效性尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 基于蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）的LLM引导方法，通过层次化候选扩展机制整合局部和全局上下文，使用复合奖励函数（功能正确性FC、局部内容充分性LCA、流畅性）优化摘要。
AI.result: 在VHDL-eval和Verilog-eval数据集上一致优于基线方法；消融实验验证了局部和全局扩展策略的必要性以及FC与LCA平衡的重要性；对变量重命名等浅层修改具有鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: ROSUM-MCTS是一个有效且鲁棒的HDL摘要框架，为强化学习增强的代码摘要研究开辟了新方向。

title: SKILL.nb: Selective Formalization and Gated Execution for Durable Agent Workflows
summary: AI agents increasingly turn past experience into reusable artifacts such as code, workflows, and procedural memories. Reuse can improve efficiency, but it also creates a lifecycle reliability problem: artifacts that succeed once may fail under environment drift, underspecified tasks, or changing task distributions, especially in web automation. We introduce SKILL.nb, a framework for governing reusable agent workflows with evidence-calibrated lifecycle policies. SKILL.nb uses selective formalization: execution evidence decides which workflow steps should become executable code, which should remain natural-language guided, and when those choices should be revised. Workflows are stored as auditable, versioned notebooks that interleave natural-language guidance, multi-language executable cells, validation gates, fallback paths, and multimodal evidence such as outputs, screenshots, and error traces. At runtime, gate-conditioned execution lets each step run code when its gates validate, or fall back locally when drift invalidates the executable realization. On WebArena-Verified, SKILL.nb achieves 53.7% single-round success, improving over the strongest baseline by 3.9 percentage points. Across three re-executions, it retains 91.7% of initially successful tasks, 15.5 points above the next best method. Under bounded repair, it recovers 72.9% of subsequent failures while limiting post-repair regressions to 4.2%, compared with 15.0% to 17.0% for persistent baselines. It also leads on Mind2Web cross-website and cross-domain splits. In a GitLab migration test, SKILL.nb preserves performance when reusing frozen state learned on GitLab 15.7, with frozen-versus-fresh target-version gaps of -1.7 points on GitLab 16.11 and +0.6 points on GitLab 18.9. These results identify lifecycle governance and gate-conditioned execution as reliability axes beyond one-shot task success.

AI.tldr: SKILL.nb 是一个用于管理可复用智能体工作流的框架，通过证据校准的生命周期策略和门控条件执行，在Web自动化中实现了更高的可靠性和鲁棒性，相比基线方法在成功率、持续性和故障恢复等方面均有显著提升。
AI.motivation: AI智能体将过往经验转化为可复用工件（如代码、工作流），虽然提升了效率，但也带来了生命周期可靠性问题——工件在环境漂移、任务欠指定或任务分布变化时容易失效，尤其在Web自动化领域。现有方法缺乏对工件何时该固化、何时该回退的动态治理机制。
AI.method: SKILL.nb 采用选择性形式化策略：根据执行证据决定工作流步骤应转为可执行代码还是保留为自然语言引导，并动态调整。工作流存储为可审计、版本化的笔记本，包含自然语言指导、多语言可执行单元、验证门、回退路径以及多模态证据（输出、截图、错误轨迹）。运行时通过门控条件执行，当验证通过时运行代码，环境漂移导致失效时则本地回退。
AI.result: 在WebArena-Verified上，单轮成功率达53.7%，比最强基线高3.9个百分点；三次重执行保留91.7%初始成功任务，高出第二名15.5个百分点；有限修复下恢复72.9%后续故障，回归率仅4.2%（基线15%-17%）。在Mind2Web跨网站/跨域任务上同样领先。GitLab迁移测试中，冻结版本与新鲜版本间差距仅为-1.7和+0.6个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 生命周期治理和门控条件执行是超越一次性任务成功率的重要可靠性维度，SKILL.nb 证明了这些机制在智能体工作流长期复用中的有效性。

title: LEAF: Growing Trees Without Branching for Speech-Aware Large Language Model Post-Training
summary: State-of-the-art GRPO-style methods for speech-aware large language model post-training suffer from coarse credit assignment, broadcasting the same terminal-reward advantage to every token in a response. This ignores useful structure within rollout batches, where speech-conditioned completions often share prefixes before diverging at important decisions. We propose Low-rank Exploration with Adaptive Forking (LEAF), a retrospective tree-based RL method that recovers this structure without online branching or additional decoding. LEAF samples complete responses, selects high-surprisal boundaries, groups responses by shared prefixes, and assigns span-level advantages using descendant rewards. We theoretically justify LEAF's span-level credit assignment and boundary-selection design. Empirically, LEAF improves over GRPO across speech question answering and speech translation benchmarks under the same rollout and low-rank adaptation budget. Notably, smaller LEAF-trained models outperform current state-of-the-art, full-parameter baselines.

AI.tldr: LEAF是一种基于回溯树的强化学习方法，通过自适应分叉和低秩探索，在语音大模型后训练中实现片段级信用分配，超越GRPO等现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的GRPO风格方法在语音感知大语言模型后训练中存在粗粒度信用分配问题，将相同的终端奖励优势广播给响应中的每个token，忽略了语音条件补全中共享前缀后分叉的有用结构信息。
AI.method: 提出LEAF方法：采样完整响应，选择高信息量边界，按共享前缀对响应分组，利用后代奖励分配片段级优势。无需在线分支或额外解码。
AI.result: 在语音问答和语音翻译基准测试中，相同预算下LEAF优于GRPO；更小的LEAF模型超越了当前最先进的full-parameter基线。
AI.conclusion: LEAF通过回顾式树结构实现更精细的信用分配，验证了片段级优势设计的理论合理性和实际有效性。

title: Illusions of the Gold Standard: A Large-scale Analysis of Human Evaluation Protocols for Long-form Text Generation
summary: Human evaluation plays a critical role in assessing the quality of generated text. However, the reliability and reproducibility of these evaluations depend on transparent and well-documented protocols -- details that are frequently missing in current practice. In this work, we conduct a large-scale analysis of human evaluation protocols for evaluating long-form generation tasks in *CL conference publications from 2023--2025, including a full manual review of 284 papers and LLM-assisted analysis for another 1.8k+ papers. We define a set of 20 reportable criteria related to reproducibility of human evaluation studies, and apply these criteria to systematically examine reporting norms and practices within the community. We find widespread under-reporting of important aspects of human evaluation study design, leading to ambiguity about what was measured and how, who contributed judgments, and how judgments should be interpreted. Based on these findings, we outline actionable recommendations to support more transparent and reproducible reporting in future research. Our analysis code and annotated dataset can be found at: https://github.com/larchlab/Illusions-of-the-Gold-Standard

AI.tldr: 对2023-2025年*CL会议论文中长文本生成任务的人工评估协议进行大规模分析，发现报告严重不足，并提出改进建议。
AI.motivation: 人工评估在文本质量评估中至关重要，但现有评估协议普遍缺乏透明性和可重复性，亟需系统分析当前报告实践中的不足。
AI.method: 定义20项可报告标准，对284篇论文进行完整人工评审，并借助LLM分析另外1800+篇论文，系统检视人工评估研究的报告规范。
AI.result: 发现人工评估研究设计中重要方面普遍报告不足，导致评估内容、方式、评判者及结果解读存在模糊性。
AI.conclusion: 基于发现提出可操作建议，以促进未来研究更透明、可重复的报告实践。

title: How Small Can You Go? LoRA Fine-Tuning 270M-8B Models for Merchant Information Extraction in Financial Transactions
comment: 9 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables. Submitted to the IEEE International Conference on Data Mining (ICDM) 2026
summary: Financial transaction processing requires extracting structured merchant information from noisy, abbreviated bank transaction strings at scale. Our current production system, a LoRA-fine-tuned LLaMA 3.1-8B, achieves 96.95% F1 on this task, but deploying 8-billion-parameter models imposes prohibitive memory, latency, and cost constraints. To identify more efficient alternatives, we conduct a deployment-focused study of 24 model variants spanning four model families: Gemma 3 (270M, 1B, 4B), Qwen 3.5 (0.8B, 2B, 4B), Aya (3.35B), and LLaMA 3.1-8B, systematically evaluating accuracy, inference throughput, training cost, and hardware behavior to assess production suitability. Our findings show that: (1) reproducing the LLaMA 3.1-8B fine-tune with a LoRA rank of 8 achieves 96.75% F1, only 0.20 points below the rank-32 baseline; (2) Qwen 3.5 4B with JSON-only prompting reaches 96.60% F1, within 0.35 points of the 8B baseline while using roughly half the parameters; (3) the 0.8B Qwen 3.5 model achieves 94.75% F1, matching models 2.5-4x larger and offering an attractive latency-accuracy trade-off; (4) chain-of-thought fine-tuning generally improves F1 by 0.3-1.8 points across most models, although Qwen 3.5 4B performs best with direct JSON-only prompting; and (5) Qwen 3.5 Think and Nothink training templates produce nearly identical results (F1 differences <0.004), indicating that explicit reasoning supervision is unnecessary for structured extraction tasks. We further deploy all 14 fine-tuned sub-8B models as Databricks Model Serving endpoints and observe that benchmark performance transfers reliably to production, with an average F1 change of only 0.8 points. Aya 3.35B, based on the Cohere2 architecture, is the sole exception, exhibiting a 3-5 point decline under serving conditions. Based on these results, we provide deployment recommendations across accuracy and latency requirements, ...

AI.tldr: 本研究系统评估了24个模型变体在金融交易结构化信息提取任务上的表现，发现Qwen 3.5 4B等小模型能以接近8B模型的精度提供更高效的部署方案，并提供了面向不同精度和延迟需求的部署建议。
AI.motivation: 生产系统中使用的LoRA微调LLaMA 3.1-8B模型虽然精度高（96.95% F1），但80亿参数导致内存、延迟和成本过高，亟需寻找更高效的替代方案。
AI.method: 对四个模型家族（Gemma 3、Qwen 3.5、Aya、LLaMA 3.1）的24个变体进行系统评估，比较精度、推理吞吐量、训练成本和硬件行为，并在Databricks Model Serving上部署14个<8B的微调模型进行生产验证。
AI.result: (1) LoRA rank=8复现8B基线仅下降0.20 F1；(2) Qwen 3.5 4B JSON-only提示达96.60% F1，参数减半；(3) Qwen 3.5 0.8B达94.75% F1，匹配2.5-4倍大模型；(4) CoT微调普遍提升0.3-1.8 F1；(5) Think/NoThink模板差异<0.004 F1；(6) 生产部署F1平均仅下降0.8点，除Aya 3.35B外。
AI.conclusion: 小模型可在保持接近大模型精度的同时显著降低部署成本，为不同精度和延迟需求提供了具体的模型选择建议。

title: Measuring Poverty and Inequality with Reduced Data: A Machine Learning Approach Using Nigerian Household Data
summary: Reliable measurement of income and consumption is essential for monitoring poverty and inequality in low- and middle-income countries, yet full household surveys are costly and difficult to implement regularly. This paper examines whether reduced survey instruments can preserve key distributional information. We apply Random Forest Recursive Feature Elimination (RF-RFE) to the 2018/19 Nigeria General Household Survey-Panel to identify the income sources, consumption categories and household characteristics that best classify individuals within the welfare distribution. The analysis focuses on three outcomes: poverty status, location in the quintile distribution and position relative to the Gini-based inequality line. The survey's post-planting and post-harvest periods allow us to assess performance under different seasonal contexts. Results show that RF-RFE achieves strong classification accuracy with few predictors. For consumption, poverty status and inequality-line position are accurately predicted using a small set of expenditure categories, while quintile classification reaches about 80 percent accuracy for seasonal consumption and 60--65 percent for annual consumption predicted from a single seasonal visit. For income, poverty status reaches around 90 percent accuracy with five predictors, and inequality-line position is largely captured by labour earnings. The findings suggest that machine-learning methods can help improve survey design and reduce data requirements while retaining much of the distributional information needed to measure and monitor poverty and inequality.

AI.tldr: 本文利用随机森林递归特征消除（RF-RFE）方法，研究了能否通过精简调查工具保留收入与消费的关键分布信息，以降低贫困和不平等监测成本。基于2018/19年尼日利亚家庭调查数据，结果显示少量预测变量即可实现较高的分类精度，机器学习有助于优化调查设计。
AI.motivation: 低收入和中等收入国家定期开展全面家庭调查成本高昂且实施困难，因此需要探索是否可以通过精简调查指标，在保留关键分布信息的同时降低数据收集成本。
AI.method: 采用随机森林递归特征消除（RF-RFE）方法，对2018/19年尼日利亚通用家庭调查面板数据进行分析，识别最能区分福利分布的收入来源、消费类别和家庭特征；评估贫困状态、五分位分布位置及基于基尼的不平等线位置三个维度的分类表现，并考虑不同季节背景。
AI.result: 消费方面，少量支出类别即可准确预测贫困状态与不平等线位置；五分位分类在季节性消费上达到约80%准确率，年度消费（单次季访预测）约60-65%。收入方面，五个预测变量下贫困状态准确率约90%，劳动收入基本可捕获不平等线位置信息。
AI.conclusion: 机器学习方法有助于改进调查设计、降低数据采集需求，同时保留测量和监测贫困与不平等所需的大部分分布信息。

title: From `May' to `Is': Certainty Distortion in Language Model Rewriting
summary: Humans increasingly turn to Language Models (LMs) in ways that shape beliefs and drive decisions, including discussing, rewriting, and summarizing information from scientific articles, news, and medical reports. However, in these domains, where how confidently a claim is expressed matters, little is known about whether LMs faithfully preserve it. In this work, we investigate certainty distortion in LMs, defined as meaningful changes in expressed certainty when semantic content is preserved. We propose an LM-based evaluation metric that is consistent with population-level judgments of certainty. Using this metric, we characterize certainty distortion across different sizes and families of models in the context of scientific and medical communication tasks. Our results show that certainty distortion affects up to 75\% of LM outputs and is systematically asymmetric in rewriting tasks with most LMs being 1.5-2$\times$ more likely to increase the expressed certainty than to decrease it. These effects can compound over repeated paraphrasing: in the medical domain, claude-haiku-4-5 increases certainty of 20\% examples after a single iteration, increasing to 40\% after five iterations. Prompt-based interventions reduce overall certainty distortion but do not eliminate it. Together, these findings reveal a general bias toward inflating expressed certainty, with direct implications for users who rely on LMs in high-stakes domains.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了语言模型在保留语义内容时对表达确定性（certainty）的改变，称为“确定性扭曲”（certainty distortion）。研究发现，在科学和医学交流任务中，高达75%的LM输出存在确定性扭曲，且模型更倾向于（1.5-2倍）增加而非降低确定性；多次迭代会加剧这一偏差，提示干预无法完全消除该问题。
AI.motivation: 人类越来越多地依赖语言模型处理科学论文、新闻和医学报告等高风险领域的信息，这些领域中表达确定性（confidence）至关重要，但现有研究未知LM能否忠实地保留原文的确定性水平。
AI.method: 提出一种与人群判断一致的基于LM的确定性评估指标；在不同规模和家族的语言模型上，针对科学和医学交流任务（如改写）测量确定性扭曲的程度、方向及累积效应。
AI.result: 确定性扭曲影响多达75%的LM输出；改写任务中，模型将确定性提高的可能性是降低的1.5-2倍；多次迭代后确定性膨胀加剧（如claude-haiku-4-5在医学领域从单次20%增至5次迭代后40%）；提示干预可减少但无法消除该扭曲。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型存在系统性夸大表达确定性的偏差，这对依赖LM的高风险领域用户具有直接影响，提示需要进一步研究如何控制这一偏差。

title: A Multi-modal Agentic Co-pilot for Evidence Grounded Computational Pathology
summary: Pathology is the cornerstone of modern medicine, where accurate decision-making relies heavily on evidence-based practices. While artificial intelligence (AI) has the potential to transform clinical workflows, the intersection of AI and evidence-based medicine remains under-explored, with primitive attempts restricted to text-only general medicine. In this work, we present PathPocket, a multimodal AI agentic co-pilot designed specifically for evidence grounded pathology. We construct the most comprehensive pathology evidence corpus to date, encompassing approximately 110,472 public and authorized documents structured across a rigorous hierarchy of evidence from clinical guideline to expert opinion. From this meticulously graded foundation, we build a large-scale multimodal pathology hypergraph containing over 4.55 million entities and 7.10 million relations. Serving as a robust knowledge engine, this hypergraph provides traceable evidence for a collaborative multi-agent reasoning framework integrating input understanding, evidence retrieval, filtering, and diagnosis generation. This enables PathPocket to seamlessly resolve a wide spectrum of clinical tasks, ranging from text-only queries to complex multimodal diagnostics involving region-of-interest (ROI) and gigapixel whole-slide images (WSIs). We rigorously evaluate the system on a multidimensional benchmark of over 200,000 real-world cases, where it significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-arts. Crucially, extensive user studies demonstrate that PathPocket substantially improves the diagnostic accuracy and confidence of pathologists. By directly grounding pathology interpretations in verifiable literature, PathPocket offers a practical and scalable solution for the future of evidence grounded computational pathology.

AI.tldr: PathPocket是一个面向病理学的多模态AI智能体系统，构建了包含约11万份文献的循证语料库和超过455万个实体、710万条关系的超图知识引擎，通过多智能体协同推理框架，在20万真实病例基准上显著优于现有方法，并能有效提升病理学家的诊断准确率和信心。
AI.motivation: AI与循证医学在病理学领域的交叉研究尚不充分，现有尝试仅局限于纯文本的通用医学，缺乏针对病理学的多模态循证AI系统。
AI.method: 构建了最大规模的病理学循证语料库（约11万份文献），基于证据层级结构建立了包含455万+实体和710万+关系的多模态病理超图作为知识引擎，并设计了包含输入理解、证据检索、过滤和诊断生成的协同多智能体推理框架。
AI.result: 在20万+真实病例的多维基准测试中显著超越现有最先进方法，用户研究表明能显著提升病理学家的诊断准确率和信心。
AI.conclusion: PathPocket通过将病理学解释直接锚定在可验证文献上，为未来循证计算病理学提供了实用且可扩展的解决方案。

title: Structured Neuron Pruning in Deep Neural Networks Using Multi-Armed Bandits
summary: Deep neural networks often contain redundant hidden units. Removing individual weights can reduce parameter count, but unstructured sparsity is not always easy to exploit in standard dense implementations. This paper develops a structured pruning framework in which complete neurons are removed using multi-armed bandit (MAB) algorithms. Each candidate neuron is treated as an arm; pulling an arm temporarily masks that neuron, measures the change in loss on a sampled mini-batch, restores the neuron, and updates an estimate of its safe-removal reward. The framework supports stochastic policies, including Epsilon-Greedy, Softmax, UCB1 and Thompson Sampling, and multiplicative-weight policies, including Hedge-style multiplicative weights and EXP3. We evaluate the method on tabular classification, tabular regression and deep neural-network benchmarks covering image, text and reasoning tasks. Statistical comparisons using the Friedman test followed by the Nemenyi post-hoc test show significant differences between methods. On tabular classification tasks, UCB1 obtains the highest mean rank among pruning policies and improves on the unpruned neural network. On regression tasks, UCB1 obtains the highest mean rank and is statistically competitive with, or superior to, several standard regression models according to R^2. On deep-learning tasks, UCB1 and Thompson Sampling obtain the strongest ranks, and several MAB policies significantly outperform the unpruned model, magnitude-based neuron pruning and greedy activation-variation pruning. The results show that MAB-based neuron pruning is an effective and computationally practical approach for structured model reduction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于多臂老虎机（MAB）的结构化剪枝框架，通过将每个神经元视为一个臂，临时遮蔽并评估其移除对损失的影响，从而决定是否删除完整神经元。实验表明，UCB1和Thompson Sampling等策略在多个任务上显著优于未剪枝模型及其他剪枝方法。
AI.motivation: 深度神经网络常包含冗余隐藏单元，传统非结构化剪枝虽能减少参数量，但难以在标准密集实现中高效利用。因此需要一种结构化剪枝方法，直接移除完整神经元以实现模型压缩。
AI.method: 将每个候选神经元视为一个臂，拉动臂时临时遮蔽该神经元，在采样小批量上测量损失变化，然后恢复神经元并更新其安全移除奖励估计。支持随机策略（Epsilon-Greedy、Softmax、UCB1、Thompson Sampling）和乘性权重策略（Hedge-style、EXP3）。
AI.result: 在表格分类任务中，UCB1获得最高平均秩次且优于未剪枝网络；在表格回归任务中，UCB1平均秩次最高，且在R²指标上与多个标准回归模型具有竞争力或更优；在深度学习任务中，UCB1和Thompson Sampling表现最强，多个MAB策略显著优于未剪枝模型、基于幅度的神经元剪枝和贪婪激活变化剪枝。
AI.conclusion: 基于MAB的神经元剪枝是一种有效且计算实用的结构化模型缩减方法。

title: What Does Debiasing Really Remove? A Geometric Study of PCA-Based Gender Debiasing in Word Embeddings
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures. Source code available at https://github.com/AlexeyKresin/embedding-bias-geometry
summary: Debiasing methods based on principal component analysis (PCA) are broadly used to reduce gender bias in word embeddings used in LLMs, yet it remains unclear what aspects of bias they actually remove and how destructive this process is. These methods are based on the understanding that bias resides in a low-dimensional subspace, with the assumption that most of it can be captured by a few principal components. In this work, we conduct a systematic geometric analysis of PCA-based gender debiasing and investigate what is actually removed from the embedding space. Our experiments across multiple embeddings show that direct gender bias is primarily concentrated in the first principal component, supporting the low-rank bias hypothesis. However, associative bias measured by WEAT does not align with these principal directions and is instead spread across multiple embedding dimensions. Furthermore, as expected, we demonstrate that removing an increasing number of principal components leads to a consistent degradation of the embedding geometry, affecting semantic structure and vector relationships. These results reveal that PCA-based debiasing operates as a trade-off: while it effectively reduces certain forms of direct bias, it fails to eliminate distributed associations and introduces geometric distortion. Moreover, there is no universal optimal level of debiasing, as the balance between bias reduction and semantic preservation depends on the chosen metric and embedding. Overall, our findings suggest that bias in word embeddings is not purely low-rank and that simple subspace removal methods may be insufficient for comprehensive debiasing.

AI.tldr: 本文系统分析了基于PCA的词嵌入性别去偏方法，发现直接性别偏差主要集中在前几个主成分，但关联性偏差分散在多维空间中；去除主成分虽能减少某些偏差，但会破坏嵌入几何结构，且不存在通用的最优去偏水平。
AI.motivation: 基于PCA的去偏方法被广泛使用，但其实际去除的是何种偏差、过程对嵌入空间的破坏程度尚不明确，需要系统性几何分析来揭示其内在机制。
AI.method: 在多个词嵌入上对PCA去偏方法进行系统性几何分析，研究直接性别偏差（主成分方向）和关联性偏差（WEAT度量）的分布特征，以及逐步移除主成分对嵌入几何结构和语义关系的影响。
AI.result: 直接性别偏差主要集中在第一主成分上，支持低秩偏差假设；但关联性偏差（WEAT）不沿主成分方向分布，而是分散在多个嵌入维度中。此外，移除越来越多的主成分会持续降低嵌入几何质量，影响语义结构。
AI.conclusion: PCA去偏存在权衡：能有效减少某些直接偏差，但无法消除分散的关联性偏差，同时引入几何扭曲。词嵌入中的偏差并非纯低秩结构，简单的子空间去除方法不足以实现全面去偏。

title: When Does Delegation Beat Majority? A Delegation-Based Aggregator for Multi-Sample LLM Inference
summary: Majority voting over sampled answers is the dominant unsupervised aggregator for multi-sample LLM inference. We show that piping the signals every sample carries into a delegation-based aggregator (Propagational Proxy Voting, PPV) yields an unsupervised consensus rule that beats majority on MMLU-Pro by +1.5 pp overall and +2.24 pp on the non-trivial subset (paired McNemar p ~ 1.0e-14, n = 8,099). Majority discards two free signals every sample carries: within-group letter entropy and between-group reasoning geometry. PPV exposes two per-voter levers that consume exactly these signals: WHEN (how much weight a voter keeps on its own pick) and WHOM (how it splits the remainder across peers). We drive WHEN with letter entropy and WHOM with per-question-centered embedding cosine. The method needs no gold labels and no auxiliary training: per question, we partition 128 sampled generations into 16 groups, compute each group's letter-level semantic entropy and reasoning embedding centroid, and feed both into a stochastic delegation matrix whose stationary distribution selects the consensus answer. We walk through an example in which PPV overturns a clear 10-6 majority for the wrong letter: the 10-voter majority cluster is geometrically incoherent (mean within-cluster cosine -0.02) while the 6-voter minority is tight (+0.26), so propagated delegation mass concentrates on the minority's answer even though entropy alone would keep the majority ahead. We further report delegation strategies with negative results that constrain the design space for unsupervised LLM aggregation: no within-question ensemble of confidence modes closes the oracle gap.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为PPV的无监督聚合方法，通过利用样本中的字母熵和推理几何特征，将多数投票改进为基于委托的投票机制，在MMLU-Pro上提升了1.5个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有多数投票方法丢弃了每个样本携带的两个关键信号：组内字母熵和组间推理几何结构，导致聚合结果次优。
AI.method: 将128个生成样本分为16组，计算各组字母熵（驱动WHEN杠杆）和推理嵌入质心（驱动WHOM杠杆），构建随机委托矩阵，利用其稳态分布选择共识答案。
AI.result: 在MMLU-Pro上整体提升1.5个百分点，在非平凡子集上提升2.24个百分点（McNemar检验p≈1.0e-14）；成功纠正了一个10-6多数投票错误的案例。
AI.conclusion: PPV无需真实标签和辅助训练，即可用样本内置信信号替代多数投票，但置信度集成等方法无法缩小与Oracle的差距。

title: Item Response Scaling Laws: A Measurement Theory Approach for Efficient and Generalizable Neural Scaling Estimation
summary: Scaling laws provide a fundamental framework for understanding the performance of Language Models (LMs), yet deriving them requires prohibitively expensive evaluations across thousands of checkpoints or millions of inference samples. To address this, we introduce Item Response Scaling Laws (IRSL), a unified framework that integrates Item Response Theory (IRT) within the scaling law framework. Unlike traditional approaches that treat each model-benchmark pair in isolation, IRSL disentangles latent model ability from question characteristics, factorizing the scaling law estimation for $M$ models and $N$ questions to significantly reduce parameter complexity from $O(M \times N)$ to $O(M + N)$. We instantiate IRSL with Beta-IRT, which leverages the empirical probability responses of LMs -- such as token probabilities in pre-training and pass rates in test-time sampling -- to capture richer signals than binary responses. We validate our approach across two prevalent scaling paradigms: (1) pre-training downstream scaling, using 6,612 LM checkpoints and 37,682 questions from 10 benchmarks; and (2) test-time scaling, using 12 LMs and 120 questions from 4 benchmarks with up to 2,500 samples per question. Given a one-time calibration on existing model responses, IRSL yields more reliable scaling estimates using only 50 questions per benchmark (a 99.9\% reduction), achieving comparable or superior decision accuracy to traditional approaches. Furthermore, we show that the estimated latent model abilities are generalizable, enabling accurate performance forecasting across benchmarks that share the same measurement objective.

AI.tldr: 本文提出IRSL框架，将项目反应理论融入缩放律，将参数复杂度从O(M×N)降至O(M+N)，仅需50个问题（减少99.9%）即可获得可靠的缩放估计。
AI.motivation: 传统缩放律的估计需要在数千个检查点或数百万推理样本上进行评估，成本过高且计算密集。
AI.method: 提出IRSL框架，结合项目反应理论与缩放律；实例化Beta-IRT模型，利用语言模型的概率响应（如token概率、通过率）捕获更丰富信号；将参数复杂度从O(M×N)降至O(M+N)。
AI.result: 在预训练缩放（6,612个检查点，37,682个问题）和测试时缩放（12个LM，120个问题，每问题最多2,500样本）两个范式上验证；仅需50个问题（减少99.9%）即可达到与传统方法相当甚至更优的决策准确性。
AI.conclusion: IRSL能显著降低缩放律估计成本，且估计的潜在模型能力具有泛化性，可跨基准进行准确性能预测。

title: Neutrality Bites: Gender Representation in AI-Generated Animal Stories
comment: FAccT(ACM Conference on Fairness, Accountability, and Transparency) 2026
summary: Gender bias in AI-generated stories is a well-documented problem. While much attention has been paid to reducing or mitigating this bias, it is not always clear whether interventions produce genuinely fairer results. To investigate this issue, we examine how large language models (LLMs) handle gender assignment in a narrative context that is popular, highly ambiguous, and also known to closely reproduce human stereotypes: stories about talking animals. We prompt six leading LLMs to complete an English-language story about seven different anthropomorphic animal characters whose gender is unstated. We additionally iterate with four different narrative settings and a range of model temperatures. Across the 23.8K stories, we find that models frequently avoid gendering the animal character in the story (19% on average) or use gender-neutral language like "it" or "its" (38.2% on average). However, when gender is assigned, there is a significant masculine bias. Feminine animal characters are virtually absent, present in just 2.2% of stories vs. 40.6% that feature masculine characters. Our findings point to a broader argument: neutrality bites. In other words, models that prioritize neutrality to address social bias may actually contribute to the erasure of marginalized perspectives and identities. We suggest that alternative strategies beyond neutrality need to be pursued, such as ones that more equally distribute social possibilities across imagined subjects.

AI.tldr: 通过分析23,800个AI生成的拟人化动物故事，发现模型在性别分配上存在显著男性偏向（40.6%男性 vs 2.2%女性），并且"中立性"策略实际上可能导致边缘化视角的消失。
AI.motivation: 现有的性别偏见干预措施是否真正产生公平结果尚不明确，需要系统性地研究大语言模型在高度模糊且反映人类刻板印象的叙事情境（如拟人化动物故事）中的性别分配行为。
AI.method: 对6个主流大语言模型进行迭代提示，要求完成关于7种未说明性别的拟人化动物的英文故事，结合4种不同叙事设置和多种模型温度参数，最终生成23,800个故事并分析其中的性别指代模式。
AI.result: 模型平均19%的故事避免提及动物性别，38.2%使用中性语言如"it"；但在有性别指代时，男性角色占40.6%，女性角色仅占2.2%，呈现严重的男性偏向。
AI.conclusion: "中立性"策略可能适得其反，导致边缘化视角和身份的消失；应探索超越中立性的替代策略，例如更平等地分配社会可能性。

title: PACE: Anytime-Valid Acceptance Tests for Self-Evolving Agents
summary:
Self-evolving agents improve by repeatedly proposing changes to their own prompts, skills, or workflows and keeping those that score higher on a small held-out set. Almost all effort has gone into the proposer that generates candidates; we argue the weak point is the acceptor, the rule that decides whether to commit a change. Applied hundreds of times against the same noisy dev estimate, the ubiquitous "keep it if the score went up" rule is uncontrolled adaptive multiple testing: the agent effectively p-hacks itself, accumulating false commits that make it churn and drift rather than improve.
  We recast committing as a sequential hypothesis test and propose PACE (Paired Anytime-valid Commit Evaluation), a training-free, anytime-valid commit gate. Each candidate is compared to the incumbent on identical instances and committed only when a testing-by-betting e-process accumulates decisive evidence, stopping early to save evaluations and controlling each candidate's false-commit probability at a user-set level even under optional stopping (a per-decision guarantee).
  On Qwen2.5 agents (0.5B-3B) self-evolving at the prompt level on GSM8K, SVAMP, and ARC-Challenge, greedy acceptance commits 30-42% false and 10-33% harmful edits when a genuine improvement is hidden among noisy proposals, while PACE commits the real one and essentially nothing else, matching greedy's held-out accuracy at sharply lower variance and about 18% lower evaluation cost. With no real gain available, greedy commits 13-21 spurious self-modifications per run (72-100% false) and degrades the most fragile agent by 4.9 points, while PACE holds at baseline. Reliability of self-evolution depends on the acceptor, not only on the proposer.

AI.tldr: 本文指出自我进化智能体的核心瓶颈不在于提案生成器，而在于接受机制。现有“分数提升即接受”规则本质上是失控的自适应多重检验，导致智能体自我p-hack、漂移退化。作者提出PACE（配对任意有效提交评估），一种基于序列假设检验的提交门控，通过赌博检验e-process控制假阳性率，在保持准确率的同时大幅降低虚假提交和评估成本。
AI.motivation: 现有自我进化智能体将几乎所有努力投入提案生成，但接受机制存在严重缺陷：在噪声开发集上重复使用“分数提升即接受”规则，相当于未经控制的自适应多重检验，导致智能体自我p-hack、累积虚假变更，产生漂移和退化而非真正的改进。
AI.method: 将提交问题重构为序列假设检验，提出PACE（配对任意有效提交评估）：基于testing-by-betting的e-process，将每个候选方案与现行方案在相同实例上配对比较，仅在积累决定性证据时提交变更，支持提前停止以节省评估预算，并在用户设定的水平上控制每个候选方案的假提交概率（即使存在可选停止）。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5智能体（0.5B-3B）的提示级别自我进化实验中（GSM8K、SVAMP、ARC-Challenge）：贪婪接受产生30-42%虚假提交和10-33%有害编辑，而PACE几乎只提交真正的改进；在无真正改进可用时，贪婪每次运行提交13-21次虚假自我修改（72-100%虚假），使最脆弱的智能体下降4.9个点，PACE则保持在基线水平。PACE与贪婪的保留集准确率相当，但方差显著降低，评估成本降低约18%。
AI.conclusion: 自我进化智能体的可靠性不仅取决于提案生成器，更取决于接受机制。

title: Query Lens: Interpreting Sparse Key-Value Features with Indirect Effects
summary: While sparse autoencoders provide features more interpretable than individual neurons, reliably characterizing them remains challenging. We propose Query Lens, which extends Logit Lens to enable more comprehensive and faithful interpretations of sparse features. By jointly considering encoder-side key features and decoder-side value features, we identify both the inputs that activate a feature and the outputs it promotes. We also account for indirect, module-mediated effects that arise when the feature is processed by downstream modules, going beyond the direct effect captured by Logit Lens. In experiments, we find that Query Lens yields coherent token signatures for features that remain uninterpretable under Logit Lens. Finally, we propose the Subspace Channel Hypothesis, suggesting that downstream modules read features through layer-specific subspaces.

AI.tldr: 提出Query Lens方法，通过联合考虑编码器侧关键特征和解码器侧价值特征，并考虑下游模块的间接效应，实现对稀疏自编码器特征更全面、更忠实的解释，同时提出子空间通道假说。
AI.motivation: 稀疏自编码器提供的特征虽然比单个神经元更可解释，但可靠地表征这些特征仍然具有挑战性。现有Logit Lens方法存在局限，需要更全面的解释方法。
AI.method: 提出Query Lens方法，扩展Logit Lens。通过联合考虑编码器侧关键特征和解码器侧价值特征，识别激活特征和促进输出的输入。同时考虑模块介导的间接效应，并引入子空间通道假说解释下游模块如何通过层特定子空间读取特征。
AI.result: Query Lens能够为Logit Lens下无法解释的特征产生连贯的token签名。实验验证了该方法在特征解释上的有效性。
AI.conclusion: Query Lens提供了比Logit Lens更全面、更忠实的稀疏特征解释方法，子空间通道假说为理解下游模块如何读取特征提供了新视角。

title: Defending Against Malicious Finetuning by Scaling Train-time Adversarial Attacks
summary: Current open-weight large language models (LLMs) are prone to malicious finetuning attacks, which could compromise the safety alignment of LLMs with only a few steps of supervised finetuning (SFT) on poisoned datasets. Existing alignment-stage defenses are primarily designed to defend against attacks that use parameter-efficient finetuning methods. However, they fail to defend against stronger attacks that use full-parameter finetuning. In this paper, we propose Patcher, a method inspired by adversarial training and bi-level optimization, to combat such attacks. Patcher strengthens the simulated attack by scaling up the optimization steps in the adversarial loop, thus forcing the defender to find model parameters that are insensitive to stronger attacks. Furthermore, we propose an efficient parallel algorithm to implement Patcher, decreasing the wall-clock time of training while preserving Patcher's performance. Extensive experiments show that Patcher substantially improves the model's robustness compared to vanilla SFT alignment, and transfers to diverse attack scenarios and model sizes. Code is available at https://github.com/haomingwen/patcher.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Patcher 方法，通过对抗训练和双层优化防御全参数微调攻击，提升大语言模型的安全性对齐鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有开源大语言模型易受恶意微调攻击，仅需少量有监督微调步骤即可破坏安全对齐，而现有防御方法仅能应对参数高效微调攻击，无法防御更强的全参数微调攻击。
AI.method: 提出 Patcher 方法，受对抗训练和双层优化启发，通过放大对抗循环中的优化步骤来增强模拟攻击，迫使模型找到对更强攻击不敏感的参数；同时提出高效并行算法降低训练时间。
AI.result: 实验表明 Patcher 相比标准有监督微调对齐显著提升了模型鲁棒性，并能迁移到多种攻击场景和不同模型规模。
AI.conclusion: Patcher 有效防御了全参数微调攻击，兼顾了训练效率，为开源大语言模型的安全对齐提供了更强的保障。

title: Think Before You Act: Intention-Guided Reasoning for LLM-Based Location Prediction
summary: Predicting a user's next Point-of-Interest (POI) based on their historical check-in records is a fundamental task in location-based services. While recent methods incorporating large language models have shown strong reasoning capabilities and promising results, they typically formulate the prediction task as a one-step trajectory-to-location mapping problem, making predictions prone to shallow trajectory correlations and historical frequency bias. We argue that users rarely choose locations directly and instead, they usually first form a traveling intention and then accordingly select specific POIs. Motivated by this insight, we propose IntentPOI, a two-stage intention-guided reasoning framework. In the thinking stage, we infer users' intermediate intentions by incorporating historical mobility patterns, similar peer behaviors, and the temporal contexts. In the acting stage, we first construct a compact candidate pool, and then perform intention-guided reasoning to identify locations that best align with the inferred intention. By explicitly decoupling intention inference from location prediction, IntentPOI transforms the next POI prediction from direct trajectory matching into intention-guided reasoning. Extensive experiments on three real-world datasets demonstrate that IntentPOI consistently outperforms eleven state-of-the-art baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出IntentPOI，一个两阶段意图引导推理框架，通过先推断用户出行意图再匹配具体POI，将下一POI预测从直接轨迹匹配转变为意图引导推理，在三个真实数据集上优于11个基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有方法将下一POI预测视为一步轨迹-位置映射，容易产生浅层轨迹关联和历史频率偏差；实际上用户通常先形成出行意图再选择具体位置，因此需要解耦意图推断与位置预测。
AI.method: 提出两阶段框架：(1) 思考阶段：结合历史移动模式、相似用户行为和时间上下文推断用户中间意图；(2) 行动阶段：构建紧凑候选池，进行意图引导推理以选择与意图最匹配的位置。
AI.result: 在三个真实数据集上的大量实验表明，IntentPOI一致优于11个最先进的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式解耦意图推断与位置预测，将下一POI预测从直接轨迹匹配转变为意图引导推理，有效提升了预测准确性。

title: ScaleSweep: Accurate NVFP4 Post-Training Quantization of LLMs via Block Scale Initialization
summary: NVFP4 is a recently introduced hardware-supported FP4 format that improves the fidelity of 4-bit quantization through fine-grained block scales. However, existing NVFP4 scale initialization methods still primarily rely on AbsMax initialization, which leaves a noticeable gap to the optimal solution. To address this, we propose ScaleSweep, a simple and efficient scale optimization method that sweeps over feasible block scale candidates and selects the candidate that minimizes a target objective. We further provide a theoretical analysis of NVFP4 quantization and derive both lower and upper bounds for the required sweep range under mean square error (MSE) and weighted mean square error (WMSE) between the original tensor and the quantized reconstructed tensor. The proposed bounds substantially reduce the sweep space while preserving the optimal candidate, enabling negligible overhead compared with the baseline quantization operators. Experiments on Llama and Qwen models demonstrate that ScaleSweep consistently improves quantization performance over existing initialization methods and further narrows the gap to full precision. In particular, under aggressive end-to-end quantization of weights, activations, KV cache, and query states, ScaleSweep preserves more than 93% of the full-precision performance.

AI.tldr: 提出ScaleSweep方法，通过扫描可行的块缩放因子候选值来优化NVFP4量化中的缩放因子初始化，理论推导了扫描范围的下界和上界，在Llama和Qwen模型上验证了有效性，在端到端量化场景下保留了93%以上的全精度性能。
AI.motivation: 现有NVFP4缩放因子初始化主要依赖AbsMax方法，与最优解之间存在显著差距，需要更优的缩放因子初始化方案。
AI.method: 提出ScaleSweep方法，通过扫描可行的块缩放因子候选值并选择最小化目标函数的候选值；理论推导了MSE和WMSE下扫描范围的下界和上界，大幅缩减搜索空间。
AI.result: 在Llama和Qwen模型上，ScaleSweep持续优于现有初始化方法，进一步缩小了与全精度的差距；在激进的端到端量化（权重、激活、KV缓存和查询状态）下，保留了93%以上的全精度性能。
AI.conclusion: ScaleSweep是一种简单高效的NVFP4缩放因子优化方法，通过理论指导的扫描范围缩减，在几乎不增加开销的情况下显著提升了量化性能。

title: MechLens: Late Crystallization of Factual Knowledge Explains Intervention Effectiveness in Language Models
summary:
Understanding where LLMs store factual knowledge is critical for hallucination mitigation. We systematically quantify Late Crystallization: factual knowledge does not gradually emerge across layers but "crystallizes" abruptly at the final layers. Across five model families (Pythia, Gemma, Qwen2.5, Llama-3.1, Mistral; 0.5--14B), 26.8%--93.4% of correct answers never enter top-10 predictions at any intermediate layer, with late emergence (>80% depth) consistent across architectures. Cross-scale (Qwen2.5-14B) and cross-benchmark (MMLU: 98.2%) results confirm generality; tuned lens rules out probe artifacts. A sentiment-classification control (0.5% for Qwen vs. 85.9% factual; 2.0% for Mistral vs. 26.8%) confirms the phenomenon is specific to factual recall.
  Late Crystallization yields a crystallization-guided intervention principle: CAA outperforms DoLa on moderate-crystallization models (Llama, Mistral; p<0.001), with a directionally consistent reversal on high-crystallization Qwen (+25.4% vs. +15.5% MC1, p=0.069). LayerNorm ablation shows crystallization is intrinsic to the residual stream; LN scaling (x1.2) yields +11.8% MC1 with zero inference overhead. We further reveal a Computability-Memorization Spectrum: computable knowledge crystallizes earlier (layer 22.1/28) than memorized facts (28.0/28). We release MechLens supporting five model families.

AI.tldr: LLM中的事实知识并非逐层渐进涌现，而是在最后几层突然"结晶"形成，这种现象被称为"晚期结晶"。
AI.motivation: 理解LLM存储事实知识的位置对于缓解幻觉问题至关重要，现有研究未能精确量化知识涌现的时间模式。
AI.method: 在五个模型家族（Pythia、Gemma、Qwen2.5、Llama-3.1、Mistral；0.5-14B）上系统量化了晚期结晶现象，并通过tuned lens排除探针伪影，以情感分类任务作为对照实验。
AI.result: 26.8%-93.4%的正确回答在中间层从未进入top-10预测；跨规模和跨基准测试（MMLU：98.2%）验证了普遍性；情感分类控制实验证实该现象是事实回忆特有的。
AI.conclusion: 提出结晶引导的干预原则（CAA优于DoLa），LayerNorm消融验证了结晶是残差流的内在属性，揭示可计算知识比记忆化知识更早结晶，并发布MechLens工具支持五个模型家族。

title: Cross-LLM Consistency in Inference: Evidence from Shared Interactions
summary: Large language models (LLMs) differ in architecture, training data, and optimization procedures, yet they may still develop similar internal inference patterns. In this paper, we examine this hypothesis using interaction-based explanations. We find that LLMs often share interaction patterns when predicting the same target token from the same prompt. This consistency is more pronounced among advanced LLMs. Shared interactions also tend to be lower-order and show weaker positive-negative cancellation than non-shared interactions. These results suggest that advanced LLMs may be implicitly optimized toward common inference patterns, even though the mechanisms that give rise to such cross-model consistency remain open.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了不同大语言模型（LLMs）在预测相同目标词时是否共享相似的内部推理模式，发现先进LLMs之间存在一致的交互模式，这些模式通常阶数较低且正负抵消较弱。
AI.motivation: 探究不同架构、数据和优化方式的大语言模型是否可能发展出相似的内部推理模式。
AI.method: 使用基于交互的解释方法（interaction-based explanations），分析不同LLMs在相同提示下预测相同目标词时的交互模式。
AI.result: 不同LLMs确实共享交互模式，且先进模型之间一致性更强；共享交互通常阶数较低，正负抵消较弱。
AI.conclusion: 先进LLMs可能被隐式优化向共同的推理模式收敛，尽管产生这种跨模型一致性的机制尚不明确。

title: Graph Neural Networks for Predicting Solvability of Finite Groups
summary: We present a Graph Neural Network (GNN) framework for the classification of finite groups according to their solvability. Using graph representations associated with finite groups, including Cayley graphs (CG), the proposed model is trained to distinguish solvable and non-solvable groups using structural graph information alone. The framework is evaluated on groups outside the training dataset in order to investigate the extent to which GNNs can learn algebraic properties arising in group theory. More broadly, the present work explores the relationship between algebraic structure and graph-based geometric representations of finite groups. The present study is intended as a proof-of-concept investigation of whether GNNs can learn algebraic properties of finite groups from graph-based representations

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个图神经网络框架，通过有限群的凯莱图等图表示来分类群的可解性，仅利用结构图信息区分可解群与非可解群，并探索GNN学习代数性质的可行性。
AI.motivation: 探索图神经网络能否从图表示中学习有限群的代数性质（特别是可解性），以及代数结构与图几何表示之间的关系。
AI.method: 使用图神经网络框架，基于有限群的图表示（包括凯莱图），训练模型仅通过结构图信息区分可解群和非可解群。
AI.result: 在训练集之外的群上评估，证明GNN能够从图表示中学习有限群的可解性等代数性质。
AI.conclusion: 作为概念验证，表明GNN可以从基于图的表示中学习有限群的代数性质，为代数与图几何表示之间的关系提供了新视角。

title: Customer-Agent: Overcoming Context Limitations in Ultra-Long Shopping Trajectories via Tool-Augmented Agents and RLVR
summary: Understanding customer shopping trajectories is essential for enabling personalized shopping experiences. However, shopping records (i.e., customer's search, clicks, purchases, etc.) often span long time horizons over multiple years, resulting in extremely long trajectories that pose significant challenges for existing large language models (LLMs). Despite the importance of this problem, existing benchmarks are limited to short customer trajectories, while real-world trajectories from large e-commerce platforms are rarely accessible due to data privacy constraints. To address this gap, we introduce ShopTrajQA, a long-context evaluation benchmark constructed from real-world product information and simulated shopping trajectories. The dataset includes variants of up to 32k and 64k tokens, enabling systematic evaluation of model robustness under varying context lengths. Through comprehensive benchmarking of frontier LLMs, we identify critical performance gaps in reasoning over long shopping trajectory data. To address these challenges, we propose a Customer Agent Framework for ultra-long context management. Leveraging a Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) agentic training paradigm, our approach stores trajectories as external local files and trains the agent to autonomously retrieve and parse them through code-interpreter interactions (e.g., SQL queries), effectively bypassing the fixed in-context window constraints of LLMs. Experimental results demonstrate that our framework achieves strong performance for ShopTrajQA and shows generalization to other complex reasoning tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ShopTrajQA基准数据集和基于RLVR的客户智能体框架，解决长购物轨迹推理难题，实验证明其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM在处理超长购物轨迹（跨越多年）时存在严重的上下文窗口限制，且缺少真实的长轨迹基准数据集。
AI.method: 构建ShopTrajQA长上下文基准数据集（含32k/64k tokens变体）；提出客户智能体框架，通过RLVR训练智能体利用代码解释器（如SQL查询）从外部文件自主检索和解析轨迹数据。
AI.result: 该框架在ShopTrajQA上取得强性能，并能泛化到其他复杂推理任务。
AI.conclusion: 通过外部存储+智能体自主检索的方式，可以有效绕过LLM的上下文窗口限制，实现超长购物轨迹的高效推理。

title: SAGE: An LLM-driven Self Reflective Agentic Framework for Fraud Detection
summary: Fraud detection in payment, e-commerce, and telecommunications systems requires accuracy at the individual level, robustness under severe class imbalance, and ease of understanding for risk managers. Existing methods fall at least one of these requirements: automated machine learning systems search a fixed numerical space without semantic awareness of the dataset; graph neural network-based methods require pre-defined relational graphs and remain opaque at the individual-decision level; and the design of general-purpose large language model (LLM) agents does not consider the recall and precision constraints specific to real-world fraud detection. In this paper, we propose SAGE, the first end-to-end LLM-driven multi-agent framework for fraud detection. SAGE coordinates three dedicated agents that make decisions based on a six-layer Data Diagnostic Tree (DDT) and a Markov decision process guided by natural-language gradients, automatically optimizing the model under a fraud-specific reward. On five fraud datasets and five LLM backbones, SAGE wins $96.00\%$ of method--dataset comparisons and improves F1 by an average of $40.86\%$ over baselines. The code is available at https://github.com/yichenC1c/SAGE.

AI.tldr: SAGE是首个端到端LLM驱动的多智能体欺诈检测框架，通过三个专用智能体、六层数据诊断树和自然语言梯度引导的马尔可夫决策过程，在五个欺诈数据集上平均提升F1值40.86%。
AI.motivation: 现有欺诈检测方法无法同时满足个体级精度、严重类别不平衡下的鲁棒性和风险管理者可理解性这三个要求：自动ML系统缺乏语义感知，GNN方法需要预定义图且决策不透明，通用LLM代理未考虑欺诈检测特有的召回率和精度约束。
AI.method: 提出SAGE框架，包含三个专用智能体（协调、优化、评估），基于六层数据诊断树（DDT）进行决策，并使用自然语言梯度引导的马尔可夫决策过程自动优化模型，在欺诈特定奖励函数下训练。
AI.result: 在五个欺诈数据集和五个LLM骨干网络上，SAGE在96%的方法-数据集对比中胜出，F1值平均提升40.86%。
AI.conclusion: SAGE作为首个端到端LLM驱动的多智能体欺诈检测框架，有效解决了现有方法的局限性，在多个数据集和LLM骨干上均取得显著性能提升。

title: HASA: Subnet Allocation for Compute-Constrained Model-Heterogeneous Federated Learning
summary: Edge services increasingly use federated learning to personalize on-device models while keeping sensitive data local. In practice, deployments must handle heterogeneity in both client resources and local data distributions. Model-heterogeneous federated learning lowers client cost by allowing each client to train a subnet of a shared supernet, but most subnet-allocation policies are driven by device constraints and do not explicitly account for statistical heterogeneity. This paper proposes Heterogeneity-Aware Subnet Allocation (HASA), a train-only rule that assigns subnet widths based on client heterogeneity scores computed from local training data while enforcing a fixed size-weighted compute budget. This design enables budget-matched comparisons with alternative allocation policies. On an article-title next-word prediction benchmark with seven clients, HASA improves unweighted mean client test accuracy over uniform allocation across 10 matched seeds, increasing mean client test accuracy from 13.82 percent to 14.32 percent, and improves worst-client accuracy on average. In a matched-budget comparison with representative partial-training baselines, HASA achieves the strongest worst-client and tail-client accuracy on this benchmark. A directionality ablation shows that assigning smaller subnets to more heterogeneous clients degrades both mean and tail performance. A cross-domain image-classification study further shows that the effectiveness of heterogeneity-aware allocation depends on how well the heterogeneity score reflects clients' need for additional model width.

AI.tldr: 本文提出异构感知子网分配（HASA）方法，通过根据客户端本地训练数据的异构性分数分配子网宽度，在固定计算预算下，相比均匀分配提升了平均和最差客户端准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有模型异构联邦学习中，子网分配策略主要考虑设备资源约束，未明确处理客户端数据分布的统计异构性问题。
AI.method: 提出HASA方法，基于客户端本地训练数据计算异构性分数，据此分配子网宽度，并强制执行固定的大小加权计算预算，实现与替代分配策略的预算匹配比较。
AI.result: 在7个客户端的下一词预测任务中，HASA将平均准确率从13.82%提升至14.32%，并改善了最差客户端准确率；在与代表性部分训练基线对比中，取得了最强的最差客户端和尾部客户端准确率。
AI.conclusion: 异构感知分配的有效性取决于异构性分数能否准确反映客户端对更大模型宽度的需求；给异构性更强的客户端分配更小子网会损害平均和尾部性能。

title: MC-PDD: Masked Corpus-Level Pretraining Data Detection for Black-Box Large Language Models
comment: The manuscript consists of 10 pages formatted in the IEEE/ACM two-column style
summary: Pretraining is fundamental to the development of Large Language Models (LLMs), yet the opacity of pretraining data complicates model analysis and raises ethical, legal, and fairness concerns. Detecting whether specific datasets were used during pretraining is, therefore, critical. Existing state-of-the-art methods typically rely on access to model probability distributions, making them unsuitable for closed-source LLMs that provide only input-output interfaces. To address this limitation, we introduce Masked Corpus-level Pretraining Data Detection (MC-PDD), a novel method inspired by the masked language modeling paradigm. MC-PDD masks highly specific tokens in each text and prompts the LLM to predict the missing content. It then assesses whether the difference in prediction hit rates between a candidate corpus and a reference non-member corpus is statistically significant. Based on this comparison, MC-PDD determines whether the candidate texts were likely included in the model's pretraining data. Experimental results demonstrate clear and consistent differences in prediction hit rates between pretrained and unseen data across three datasets, for both open-source and closed-source LLMs. Despite operating under a stricter black-box setting, MC-PDD achieves performance comparable to existing detection methods. Our approach enables practical applications such as model auditing and data copyright verification using only standard API access. Upon acceptance, we will publicly release the code and datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出MC-PDD方法，通过掩码预测和统计检验，在仅通过API访问的黑盒场景下检测LLM预训练数据是否包含特定语料，效果与现有白盒方法相当。
AI.motivation: 现有预训练数据检测方法依赖模型概率分布，不适用于仅提供输入输出接口的闭源LLM，存在伦理、法律和公平性隐患。
AI.method: 借鉴掩码语言建模范式，对文本中的高特异性token进行掩码处理，让LLM预测缺失内容；通过对比候选语料与参考非成员语料的预测命中率差异的统计显著性，判断候选文本是否属于预训练数据。
AI.result: 在三个数据集上，预训练数据与未见数据的预测命中率存在清晰一致的差异；在更严格的**黑盒设置下，性能可与现有检测方法相媲美。
AI.conclusion: MC-PDD仅需标准API访问即可实现模型审计和数据版权验证等实际应用，方法有效且可复现，代码和数据集将公开。

title: Decision-Aware Memory Cards: Counterfactual-Inspired Context Selection and Compression for Tool-Using LLM Agents
comment: 15 pages, 2 figures, 9 tables. Code and artifacts are available at https://github.com/stephen-guan-researcher/CICL; Qwen-QLoRA adapter is available at https://huggingface.co/XinyuGuan/CICL
summary: Tool-using LLM agents often fail not because relevant text is absent, but because decisive evidence is not selected, compressed, or surfaced at action time. We present CICL, a decision-aware context layer that turns instance evidence into a context graph, routes deterministic, Opus-assisted, Qwen, Codex/GPT-5.5, and Qwen-QLoRA judgments through a shared eight-field schema, scores units by action shift, outcome uplift, necessity, and negative-transfer risk, and packs high-utility evidence as typed memory cards for a budgeted agent. The design separates the measured decision signal from the judge model, so frontier annotation, local surrogates, and lightweight rankers can be compared under one auditable protocol. Empirically, CICL yields a concrete open-benchmark gain while exposing its limits. On 50 SWE-bench Verified file-retrieval instances, direct Qwen3.6-plus reranking of BM25 top-50 candidates raises hit@1 from 0.58 to 0.78 and MRR@10 from 0.634 to 0.790, with all 2,500 judgments parseable. Controlled diagnostics show action-criticality: at budget 120, CICL reaches F1 0.620 on v1 and 0.425 on v3, and removing the top-utility semantic v3 unit collapses F1 to 0.000. Supplementary checks add Qwen-QLoRA agreement over 710 candidates, a small 200-label real-code Opus-assisted signal, and a three-instance patch smoke validating retrieval-to-patch plumbing without claiming official SWE-bench success. RepoBench-R summaries still beat cards, and compact rankers do not yet replace the heuristic. CICL contributes a reproducible measurement and selection layer for decision-critical context, not an end-to-end coding-agent repair claim.

AI.tldr: CICL 是一个决策感知的上下文层，通过图结构、多模型判断和效用评分机制，提升 LLM 智能体在决策关键时刻的证据选择能力。实验显示其在代码检索等任务上有显著提升，但仍有局限。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体失败的原因往往不是缺乏相关文本，而是在行动时刻无法选择、压缩或突出最关键的证据。作者希望设计一个可测量、可比较的上下文选择层来弥补这一缺陷。
AI.method: 将实例证据构建为上下文图，通过 Opus、Qwen、Codex/GPT-5.5、Qwen-QLoRA 等模型按八字段模式进行判断，依据行动偏移、结果提升、必要性和负迁移风险对单元评分，将高效用证据打包成类型化记忆卡供预算受限的智能体使用。
AI.result: 在 SWE-bench Verified 的 50 个文件检索实例上，hit@1 从 0.58 提升至 0.78，MRR@10 从 0.634 提升至 0.790。预算 120 时 CICL 在 v1 和 v3 上分别达到 F1 0.620 和 0.425，移除最高效用单元后 F1 降为 0.000。
AI.conclusion: CICL 提供了一个可复现的测量与选择层，用于决策关键上下文，而非端到端的编码智能体修复方案。Repobench-R 摘要仍优于记忆卡，轻量级排序器尚无法替代启发式方法。

title: Airport Terminal Passenger Queue Forecasting for Departure Gates and Security Checkpoints
summary: Accurate passenger queue forecasting in airport terminals is essential for efficient departure operations, as it enables proactive congestion management. However, time-varying passenger demand and heterogeneous facility usage across multiple departure facilities make forecasting challenging. In this work, we propose a passenger queue forecasting framework that learns historical passenger flow patterns from operational data. The proposed model employs a Transformer-based architecture to capture temporal dependencies and inter-facility correlations using past queue length and waiting time at departure gates and security checkpoints, together with passenger throughput at check-in islands. The learned representations are mapped to two facility-specific MLP heads to predict queue length and waiting time at departure gates and security checkpoints. Experimental results demonstrate accurate forecasts up to two hours ahead. The proposed approach offers practical real-time decision support for proactive queue management and staff reallocation in airport terminal operations.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于Transformer的机场旅客排队预测框架，利用历史运营数据（排队长度、等待时间、吞吐量）预测未来两小时的排队情况，支持主动拥塞管理。
AI.motivation: 旅客需求随时间变化且多设施使用模式异构，导致机场航站楼的排队预测困难，现有方法难以有效应对。
AI.method: 采用Transformer架构捕捉时间依赖性和设施间相关性，输入历史排队长度、等待时间及旅客吞吐量，输出经两个MLP头分别预测登机口和安全检查点的排队长度与等待时间。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法能准确预测未来两小时内的排队情况。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能够为机场航站楼运营提供实时的决策支持，支持主动排队管理和人员调度。

title: Summarization is Not Dead Yet
summary: The progress of large language models (LLMs) has fueled claims that model-generated summaries rival or even surpass human-written references, raising questions about whether summarization remains an open research problem. We re-examine this narrative through a multi-track evaluation covering five diverse datasets and five state-of-the-art LLMs, combining controlled human assessment, bias-mitigated LLM-as-Judge protocols, factuality verification against external knowledge, and corpus-level linguistic analysis. Our findings reveal a more nuanced landscape in which human reference summaries continue to demonstrate advantages in informativeness and faithfulness, whereas LLM outputs are preferred mainly for surface-level coherence and fluency. Factuality verification indicates that human references remain more reliable, particularly for claims involving reasoning or synthesis, and linguistic analysis uncovers a pattern of stylistic homogeneity across different models. These observations suggest that current LLMs have raised the floor of summarization quality, but the ceiling of their performance remains below human capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文通过多维度评估（人工评估、LLM评判、事实核查、语言分析），发现人类撰写的摘要仍优于LLM生成的摘要，尤其在信息量和忠实度方面，而LLM仅在表面流畅性上有优势。
AI.motivation: 针对"LLM生成的摘要已超越人类"的论断，重新审视摘要生成是否仍是一个开放的研究问题。
AI.method: 采用多轨道评估，涵盖5个数据集和5个SOTA LLM，结合受控人工评估、偏差缓解的LLM评判、外部知识事实核查及语料库级语言分析。
AI.result: 人类摘要仍优于LLM摘要，尤其在信息性和忠实度方面；LLM摘要仅在流畅性和连贯性上受偏好；人类摘要事实可靠性更高；LLM存在风格同质化问题。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM提升了摘要质量的下限，但其性能上限仍低于人类能力。
